boards.title: Only Happens Here: 10 Traditions That Make No Sense Anywhere Else
boards.description: Ten documented UAlbany rituals, symbols, songs and recurring campus gatherings.

cards.title: Count Down to Fountain Day
cards.subtitle: Main Fountain, Uptown Campus
cards.notes: Watch the Main Fountain’s seasonal turning-on after the campus countdown; the University describes Fountain Day as its annual rite of spring.
cards.short_summary: A springtime countdown brings the Main Fountain’s 30-foot waters to life.
cards.evidence_claim: UAlbany identifies Fountain Day as an annual rite of spring in which a countdown precedes release of the Main Fountain’s 30-foot-high waters.
cards.source_title: Campus Tradition: Campus Unity: Fountain Day Video
cards.access_notes: A recurring spring tradition; confirm the current year’s event details with UAlbany before attending.

cards.title: Carry Forward the Torch
cards.subtitle: UAlbany Torch Night tradition
cards.notes: Learn the ceremony’s long arc: Torch Night began as the Torch Light Ceremony and Procession and dates to the 1930s.
cards.short_summary: A torch-centered academic tradition with roots in the 1930s.
cards.evidence_claim: UAlbany states that Torch Night originated as the Torch Light Ceremony and Procession and dates to the 1930s.
cards.access_notes: This is a University ceremony; consult current First-Year Experience programming for participation details.

cards.title: Light a Candle at Convocation
cards.subtitle: New-student welcome tradition
cards.notes: At the welcome ceremony, candle-lighting symbolically joins new students to UAlbany’s flame of knowledge and its class torch.
cards.short_summary: New Great Danes are ceremonially connected to the University’s flame of knowledge.
cards.evidence_claim: UAlbany describes its candle-lighting ceremony as symbolically joining each student to the University’s flame of knowledge.
cards.source_title: UAlbany Welcomes Students Back to Campus for Fall Semester
cards.access_notes: Presented during fall welcome programming; current orientation schedules determine access.

cards.title: See the Torch Pass to the Next Class
cards.subtitle: Academic Podium overlooking the Main Fountain
cards.notes: At commencement festivities, observe the symbolic torch passing from the graduating class to the class that follows.
cards.short_summary: A commencement gathering marks the symbolic handoff between UAlbany classes.
cards.evidence_claim: UAlbany calls the Torch Reception a long-standing tradition that symbolically passes the torch from one class to the next.
cards.source_title: Thousands of Great Danes Get Ready to Graduate at UAlbany
cards.access_notes: Held as part of commencement festivities; verify the current commencement schedule and attendance guidance.

cards.title: Start the Year at Great Danetopia
cards.subtitle: Annual campus resource fair
cards.notes: Use this annual welcome gathering to meet academic and student-affairs departments and locate campus resources early in the semester.
cards.short_summary: A recurring welcome event connects students with University offices and services.
cards.evidence_claim: UAlbany describes Great Danetopia as an annual event introducing students to campus resources, including academic and student-affairs departments.
cards.source_title: UAlbany Welcomes Students Back to Campus for Fall Semester
cards.access_notes: Typically part of fall welcome programming; check the current event listing for location and attendance details.

cards.title: Join the All-Class Photo
cards.subtitle: Fall welcome programming
cards.notes: Look for the scheduled all-class photo during fall welcome events; it is paired with Convocation by Candlelight in the University’s 2026 plan.
cards.short_summary: An incoming-class photo records the start of the academic year.
cards.evidence_claim: UAlbany’s Fall 2026 welcome programming lists an All-Class Photo alongside Convocation by Candlelight as traditions launching the academic year.
cards.access_notes: Scheduled within fall welcome programming; consult the current University event schedule for details.

cards.title: Learn “Purple and Gold”
cards.subtitle: UAlbany fight song
cards.notes: Listen for the fight song at spirit-focused University events, then use the official lyrics page to follow its references to Minerva and Albany.
cards.short_summary: The official fight song gives UAlbany’s Purple and Gold identity a shared chorus.
cards.evidence_claim: UAlbany lists “Purple and Gold” as its fight song and publishes its lyrics on the University traditions page.
cards.access_notes: The song is part of University tradition and may be performed at official events.

cards.title: Read the Alma Mater
cards.subtitle: UAlbany alma mater
cards.notes: Read the official alma mater lyrics and notice its teaching legacy, Minerva reference and closing salute to Albany’s Purple and Gold.
cards.short_summary: The alma mater links UAlbany’s teaching roots, Minerva and school colors.
cards.evidence_claim: UAlbany identifies “College of the Empire State” as its alma mater and publishes the lyrics.
cards.access_notes: A University song tradition; consult event programming for live performances.

cards.title: Spot Minerva, the Wisdom Symbol
cards.subtitle: Enduring University symbol
cards.notes: Use Minerva as a visual thread through UAlbany history: the Roman goddess of wisdom has represented the institution since its Normal College beginnings.
cards.short_summary: Minerva is UAlbany’s enduring symbol of wisdom.
cards.evidence_claim: UAlbany states that Minerva, the Roman goddess of wisdom, has been the institution’s enduring symbol since its New York State Normal College beginnings.
cards.access_notes: A University symbol rather than an event; view it through official University materials and campus imagery.

cards.title: Meet Damien the Great Dane
cards.subtitle: UAlbany mascot tradition
cards.notes: Watch for Damien at University spirit moments and pair the mascot with the official Purple and Gold tradition page for campus context.
cards.short_summary: Damien the Great Dane is the University’s named mascot.
cards.evidence_claim: UAlbany lists Damien the Great Dane as its mascot on the University traditions page.
cards.access_notes: Mascot appearances vary by event; check current University athletics and event information.
